dispositions.topic_text: Define INV-01's preservation scope and required proof across operations and outcomes
dispositions.what: Prove INV-01 by comparing the source folder before and after a scan, a placement, a replay and a mark: names, bytes, modification times and modes; every option keeps INV-01: no operation creates, changes, moves or deletes anything in a source folder.

dispositions.topic_text: Specify INV-02 test witnesses for every condition-1 failure branch
dispositions.what: Witness each failure branch of A3 rule 5 condition 1 by its own case, or by a table of cases in one test; check that every branch answers NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT; either way INV-02 holds: a delivery opens no path that fails condition 1.

dispositions.topic_text: Require proof that a conflict copy is never read
dispositions.what: Prove that a conflict copy is never read by a trace of openings during a scan and a delivery, or by a copy without read permission that would fail if read; check a copy in the folder and in a subfolder; either way INV-18 and INV-19 hold.

dispositions.topic_text: Specify unchanged-state assertions for earlier placement artifacts after replacement or removal
dispositions.what: Assert after a replacement or removal that the earlier stored image, placement record and mark keep their bytes, or only that they still exist with the same reference; check a replaced file and a removed one; either way A3 rule 7 holds: the earlier placement, its stored image and its mark stay.

dispositions.topic_text: Define the failure outcome when post-decode image preparation or result encoding fails
dispositions.what: prepare_photo note: a failure of an A2 rule 1 operation after decoding is the UNREADABLE_IMAGE member, or the failure the operation's own rule names; check a source that decodes but whose conversion or encoding raises; either way A3 rule 5 holds: a photo that cannot be delivered is FAILED with one PlacementFailure member, and nothing is stored.

dispositions.topic_text: Specify the exact image-library opening and decoding operations and applicable decoding limits
dispositions.what: prepare_photo note: open with Image.open restricted to SOURCE_FORMATS and read the first frame's size before decoding, or decode the first frame at once; check a truncated file and a header declaring a frame above MAX_PIXELS; either way A2 rule 2 holds: TOO_MANY_PIXELS before UNREADABLE_IMAGE for a source that opens, and INV-03.

dispositions.topic_text: Define valid EXIF date-time syntax and treatment of fractional seconds
dispositions.what: _parse_exif_moment note: accept only YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS after trailing NUL and spaces are removed (State 2 round-41 T14), or also accept a fraction; check a padded value and one with a fraction; either way A2 rule 3 holds: a malformed value is unusable and the next source of the moment applies, and INV-04.
